meshes.label: Camera retainer plate
meshes.note: The 58 × 26 retainer plate with its 24 × 14 cable window that clamps the DF200 into a camera head, print only. ONE plate serves every head this project builds: the corner mast and the DF200 wrist arch both draw their own retainer, and both name this one - the same solid to 0.005 mm, measured on the exported meshes. 2x M3 × 12 self-tapping into Ø2.60 × 9.50 pilots, 8.0 mm of bite.
